ambient_events: Boots go up the ladder, and along, and stop somewhere above you.
A bad joint gets ringed on the chalk board and a name written beside it.
Water moves in a header tank overhead and settles.
description: A frame of scaffold and salvage rail going up two storeys, with a gantry off it running away over the roofs of half the town. The whole rain harvest is up there: gutters, headers, a bank of settling tanks, all of it walked twice a day by somebody with a pot of grease and a spanner.
name: The Roofwalk
